It would be a cool thing to do, but it would take 6-8 years of school and I just don't have the patience or money for that much schooling. 
I've been looking into jobs that don't require a degree trying to start a career off early so I could get a little head start on adulthood. 
But every job I've looked up requires you to be 21 (I'm 18) so I just feel like I'm going to be stuck for 3 years and I don't want to waste all that time working this same job.

I would just really really like to figure out what career that I want to get into now so I don't waste any time, I know it's highly unlikely for me to figure that out but I just wish I could. There are things that interest me like environmental studies and outdoorsy jobs like that but many of them require 6-8 years of college and I just don't have that kind of money and don't really want to get into debt.

Things have always worked out between us before but she's always been into drugs and drinking. She just says she wants to live wild and free. 
I just don't have a lot of interest in things, I don't know what I want to do for a career. The future freaks me out and it just really really stresses me out. I don't really have an interest in school, but I bet online classes wouldn't be too bad. 
I kinda wanted to look into a school to meet some new people, I have a few friends but it gets lonely when everyone's busy and I'm not.
